panels.title: SOURCE TRACEABILITY
panels.description: Latest source, ingestion and decoder evidence for every drilling machine.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: latest ingestion and decoder metadata for every machine. */
SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_id) equipment_id AS "Machine ID",source AS "Source",source_file AS "Source File",event_time AS "Latest Event",sent_time AS "Sent",received_at AS "Received",
  ROUND((1000.0*EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at-sent_time)))::NUMERIC,1) AS "Ingestion ms",decode_status AS "Decode Status",decoder_version AS "Decoder Version",'LATEST_KNOWN' AS "State Policy"
FROM public.machine_event ORDER BY equipment_id,event_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: SETTINGS / SUPPORT BOUNDARY
panels.description: Documents operator controls and the current truth boundary.

options.content:
### Dashboard settings

- **Focus machine:** single-machine detail and history
- **Status / Program / Event:** view filters
- **Stale / STOP / Burst:** anomaly thresholds
- **Evidence rows:** raw-table limit

### Current source coverage

✅ RUN, STOP, source timestamps, Run Hits messages, NC program, tool diameter, tool life and decoded historical errors

⚠️ Not available: active-alarm lifecycle, shift calendar, vendor utilization/OEE, job progress %, total holes, RPM, axis position, power and quality/yield. Missing values remain **NO_DATA/N/A**.
